general_additions.title: Neurovirtual: Video EEG
general_additions.description: Free Spanish language course by Dr. Jorge G. Burneo of Western University. Surface video EEG, SEEG, ECoG and cortical stimulation. About 45 minutes; account and enrollment required. EEG technologist CEU credit has not been verified.

general_additions.title: NIH / NCCIH: EEG Brain Mapping and BCI
general_additions.description: Bin He, PhD presents EEG brain mapping and brain computer interfaces in a free ten chapter NIH lecture. The page mentions credit, but current EEG technologist credit eligibility and expiration have not been verified.

general_additions.title: ACNS Critical Care EEG Terminology: Condensed Version
general_additions.description: Public three page companion to the 2021 ACNS terminology, linked by the society. Background, rhythmic and periodic pattern reference. No CEU credit.

general_additions.title: ACNS Critical Care EEG Examples
general_additions.description: Public 36 page EEG example supplement linked by ACNS alongside its 2021 critical care EEG terminology. Supporting waveform reference for CLTM preparation; no CEU credit.
